sceneConcept: A thin forty-eight-year-old Chinese accountant stands alone against a transparent background. Short greying hair, a narrow face and rectangular semi-rimless glasses give him a dry, watchful appearance as he looks over the top of the frames. He wears a washed-soft grey-green old jacket without markings over a grey collared shirt, straight black trousers, a simple belt and plain dark boots. A small translucent teal accounting panel made from simple empty rectangular cells hovers above his left palm while he holds a slim stylus in his right hand. Soft even frontal studio light keeps the interface subordinate to the face. Visual refresh: a washed brown cardigan and sweater vest surrounding the floating account screen.
